parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key for this resource-creating request (ADR 0011). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-logical- request key (e.g. a UUID minted per submit): a retried request with the same key AND the same body replays the original response instead of creating a second path, while the same key with a different body is rejected 422 idempotency-key-reused, and an absent or empty key is a 400 idempotency-key-required. Postgres is the only runtime (ADR 0037), so the check is on in every deployment.
